published_prior_art.cite: HuWager2023 explicitly leaves the distributionally-overlapping-hidden-state lower construction uninvestigated.
HuWager2023 and MehrabiWager2025 establish the relevant POMDP and observed-MDP endpoints, but not this exact latent C=1 boundary.
HuWager2023 Section 5.2 supplies the simulator context; the refreshed finite discretization and certified immediate-weighting bias are new application evidence.
MehrabiWager2025 studies observable-ratio weak-overlap regimes, not a latent stationary-radius local minimax modulus.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 3, Theorem 3.1 and Lemma 3.3; Section 3.2 discussion of distributional overlap
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper proves the single-trajectory POMDP minimax lower exponent 2/(2+t0·ζπ), gives its observed-data KL hard-pair lemma, and states that constructing hard POMDP instances whose hidden states satisfy distributional overlap would be interesting but is not investigated.

The paper studies fully observed MDP OPE with truncated doubly robust estimators under weak stationary distributional overlap; square-integrable ratios recover classical behavior while weaker tails yield slower minimax regimes.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Abstract and Introduction, pp. 1–2; Appendix E.3
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper explains that latent-state density-ratio coverage alone does not control all future-dependent-value quantities and introduces outcome and belief coverage conditions for polynomial guarantees.
The paper identifies arbitrary-bias risks under partial observability and obtains positive OPE recovery for its decoupled-POMDP construction rather than the unrestricted latent-overlap class here.
The paper develops double reinforcement learning for observed-state MDP OPE using cross-fitted q-functions and marginalized density ratios, with semiparametric-efficiency results.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Make the fixed-C subclass comparison maximally auditable by adding a short explicit strict-inclusion corollary: exhibit a Hu–Wager admissible hard-chain instance whose joint stationary ratio exceeds every fixed C, alongside the signed-depth member proof.

Promote the local-radius OEQ into a finite set of candidate δT regimes by deriving preliminary upper and lower modulus envelopes; this would make the eventual crossover threshold a sharper named object.

Attach a reproducible interval-arithmetic certificate for the 360-state witness, including exact rational transition bounds and the stationary linear-system enclosure used for the stated bias interval.

recommended_next_step: Advance to Stage 0, prioritizing an independent derivation of the signed-depth observed-filtration KL bound and the finite-witness interval certificate.
